name: Metformin
description: Biguanide blood sugar medicine taken by mouth

note.text: The TAME aging trial was proposed in 2016; no registry record was found. Lifespan gains are from model systems.

bullets: **Decreases liver glucose output** and gut glucose absorption (label)
**Improves insulin sensitivity** by raising glucose uptake and use (label)
**Healthspan and lifespan** gains are from animal and model systems
**In people,** an effect on aging is not established
Aging: small trials, 14 to 94 older adults

practical.halfLife: About 6.2 hours in plasma; 17.6 hours in blood
practical.pharmacokinetics: Not metabolized by the liver; excreted unchanged in urine
practical.monitored: Kidney function (eGFR), vitamin B12, blood sugar

references: FDA, metformin hydrochloride tablets label (DailyMed), Oct 2026
Cell Metab, Metformin as a tool to target aging (TAME), Jun 2016
